control_details.Control Description: The applicable credit limit change is made by the Trade Finance team in SAP, who will not create or modify a credit limit for a customer without a change request approved by Head - Finance or due to reduction in credit insurance by the insurance company. Reduction in credit limit is due to reduction of limit from the credit insurer. It is updated in SAP by the Trade Finance team. Once updated, hard copy approval of the Head - Finance is taken and the same is communicated to the respective Sales team.

rcm_details.Control Objective: All masterfile changes are reviewed and approved.
Risks: IA5.R165 Unauthorized, inaccurate, untimely, or fraudulent adjustments to revenue and accounts receivables (including credit memos, bad debt write-offs, and discounts) are posted.
IA5.R167 Revenue is not recorded accurately or completely.
IA5.R168 Goods shipped are not recorded accurately, completely, or in the proper period.
IA5.R170 Credit limits are not properly recorded in the information system, shipments/sales orders are not within approved credit limits.
IA5.R171 Accounts receivable (including reserve for bad debt) is not valued appropriately in the financial statements.
IA5.R172 Revenue reserves (including discounts, sales returns, and rebates) are posted inaccurately, untimely, or not at all.
IA5.R197 Sales made to unauthorized/fictitious customers.
IA5.R196 Unauthorized or inaccurate changes are made to the sales price master file including discount and rebate terms which results in inaccurate invoicing.
